title: Sequencer
description: An advanced block: channels, patterns and a playlist from a .ampleseq file or kept in the song, mixed into one output and into up to eight lanes that name the channels they carry. It can read a sequence file and gives audio.

parameters.name: file
parameters.placeholder: choose a sequence file of the project
parameters.doc: The sequence file (sequences/<name>.ampleseq; a .seq file of before works too): the channels, the patterns and the playlist. The Sequencer editor writes it. The sequence can also be kept in the song itself (the sequence part of the block), which is used instead of the file.

parameters.name: lanes
parameters.doc: Which channels each lane carries: lane1=kick lane2=hat+snare lane3=all (lanes 1 to 8, channels joined by +, all for every channel). Every channel is in mix; a lane that is connected must name channels.

parameters.name: gain
parameters.doc: Output gain of the mix and of every lane.

parameters.name: sequence
parameters.doc: The sequence kept in the song itself, as a sequence { ... } part of the block (the text of a .ampleseq file). It is used instead of file. Use Embed in the song and Extract to a file in the sequencer.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).

needs: Optionally a .ampleseq file (parameter file); the sequence can also be kept in the song.
